title: netcoredbg debug configuration
description: C#/.NET debugging via netcoredbg. The launch/attach fields listed here are the ones netcoredbg's src/protocols/vscodeprotocol.cpp reads; `logging`, `launchSettingsProfile`, `launchSettingsFilePath`, `envFile`, `console`, and `pipeTransport` are consumed by this extension and stripped before forwarding. Any other field is forwarded verbatim and ignored by netcoredbg if it does not know it.

sourceFileMap.description: vscode-csharp option, IGNORED by netcoredbg (it has no source file mapping; the key appears nowhere in its source). Accepted only so configurations copied from VS Code validate; forwarded verbatim without effect.

console.description: Console mode for the debuggee. Only `internalConsole` is supported because netcoredbg does not implement DAP `runInTerminal` (no stdin/TTY). For interactive console apps, run the app from a Zed task or terminal and attach with `"processId": "${ZED_PICK_PID}"`.

pipeTransport.description: Run `netcoredbg` inside a container or over an external transport command (e.g. `docker exec -i`). Consumed by this extension and stripped before forwarding; skips local binary lookup and local DOTNET_ROOT injection.

pipeProgram.description: Local executable used to spawn the remote/containerized adapter (e.g. "docker", "kubectl", "ssh").

debuggerPath.description: Path to `netcoredbg` inside the target environment (e.g. "/vsdbg/netcoredbg").

logging.description: Diagnostics, consumed by this extension: translated into netcoredbg adapter command line flags (flag names from netcoredbg src/main.cpp) and removed from the forwarded configuration. `engine`/`engineLogging` pass --engineLogging (engine and DAP activity shown in Zed's debug console); `enginePath` passes --engineLogging=<path>; `log` passes --log (internal log in a temp file); `logPath` passes --log=<path>. The other vscode-csharp `logging` keys are accepted and ignored; unknown keys are an error. Relative paths resolve against the worktree root (the adapter's working directory); the directory must already exist — netcoredbg does not create it and silently drops the log when the file cannot be opened.

engine.description: Enable engine logging into Zed's debug console (--engineLogging).

enginePath.description: Write the engine log to this file instead of the console (--engineLogging=<path>). Implies `engine`. Relative paths resolve against the worktree root (the adapter's working directory); the directory must already exist — netcoredbg does not create it and silently drops the log when the file cannot be opened.

log.description: Enable netcoredbg's internal log (--log); it is written to <temp dir>/<executable name>.<pid>.log.

logPath.description: Write netcoredbg's internal log to this file, or "stderr" (--log=<path>). Implies `log`. "stdout" is rejected because it would corrupt the DAP stream. Relative paths resolve against the worktree root (the adapter's working directory); the directory must already exist — netcoredbg does not create it and silently drops the log when the file cannot be opened.

exceptions.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

moduleLoad.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

programOutput.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

browserStdOut.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

elapsedTiming.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

threadExit.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

processExit.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

consoleUsageMessage.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

diagnosticsLog.description: vscode-csharp option with no netcoredbg equivalent: accepted and ignored.

program.description: Path to the application to debug: an app.dll (framework-dependent) or a self-contained executable.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the project (worktree) root.

env.description: Environment variables for the debuggee. DOTNET_ROOT is injected automatically when detectable.

stopAtEntry.description: Break immediately after the program launches.

justMyCode.description: Only debug user code, skip framework/step-filtering.

enableStepFiltering.description: Step over properties and operators (Just My Code stepping).

launchSettingsProfile.description: Named profile in `launchSettingsFilePath` (defaults to `Properties/launchSettings.json`). Merges `environmentVariables`, `applicationUrl` (`ASPNETCORE_URLS`), `commandLineArgs`, and `workingDirectory` with lower precedence than explicit fields.

launchSettingsFilePath.description: Worktree-relative path to `launchSettings.json` (defaults to `Properties/launchSettings.json` when `launchSettingsProfile` is specified). When `launchSettingsProfile` is omitted, selects the first `commandName: "Project"` profile.

envFile.description: Worktree-relative path to a dotenv file (`KEY=VALUE` lines, e.g. `.env` or `${ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT}/.env`). Precedence: explicit `env` > `launchSettings` > `envFile` > `DOTNET_ROOT` hint.

processId.description: PID of the dotnet process to attach to (integer, numeric string, or "${ZED_PICK_PID}" to pick interactively).
